commitMessage:
Migrate site to AEMaaCS: static->editable templates + component-rewrite rules + legacy-ui dialog conversion

Skills: template-modernization, legacy-ui

skillGaps.title: Template thumbnail.png migration is undocumented
skillGaps.detail: The static template dir contains thumbnail.png alongside .content.xml. The skill's editable-template file list is 4 files and never mentions thumbnails, so the thumbnail is lost on migration.
skillGaps.fix: Add a rule: copy thumbnail.png to /conf/<appId>/settings/wcm/templates/<tpl>/thumbnail.png and add it to the vault filter. PNG-only, filename must be thumbnail.png.
